  | description              = This helm commemorates the Founding of Stormreach, the day that the [[Coin Lords]] first allowed adventurers free run of the city.
  | pic                      = Founder's Helm shown.png
  | picdesc                  = Founder's Helm.png
  | tips                     = 
This helm is only available to characters whose account had a character in a guild of at least 10 people by the end of the Head Start Beta Event. It's a thank you to all of our preorder customers for participating in the Head Start Event.
* This item automatically spawns in the character inventory upon creation, and will spawn on all new characters made on this account.
* In addition to this helm, Founders were given two other bonuses:
** A special forum account title, and if desired - founder only forum avatar
** Their character's name from beta was written on the founders fountain added in the game in [[Module 1]].
